ops.quote: we append two types of attention modules on top of traditional dilated FCN
the position attention module selectively aggregates the features at each position
selectively aggregates the features at each position by a weighted sum of the features at all positions
the channel attention module selectively emphasizes interdependent channel maps
integrating associated features among all channel maps
we sum the outputs of the two attention modules
which contributes to more precise segmentation results
address the scene segmentation task by capturing rich contextual dependencies
